description: This source file defines a Go package `mcp` that implements a client for communicating with MCP servers over stdin/stdout. It includes the `StdioMCPClient` struct and methods for initializing communication, performing discovery of capabilities such as tools and resources, managing subprocess execution, and parsing responses from the server.

classes.name: StdioMCPClient
classes.description: Handles communication with stdio-based MCP servers. Contains configuration such as verbosity and methods for performing discovery and protocol exchanges.

methods.name: NewStdioMCPClient
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new `StdioMCPClient` instance, with a parameter to enable verbose logging.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilitiesFromProcess
methods.description: Main method to start an MCP server process, perform handshake, and discover tools and resources.

methods.name: performDiscovery
methods.description: Performs the MCP handshake, sends initialization, and requests tools and resources listings.

methods.name: parseToolsResponse
methods.description: Parses the response containing the list of MCP tools.

methods.name: parseResourcesResponse
methods.description: Parses the response containing the list of MCP resources.
